reset.title: Reset data
reset.intro: Only parents can do this. You will confirm with your password and a typed word. A backup is taken first and kept for 30 days.
reset.factory_desc: Deletes everything, including members, pictures and settings, and returns to the first-run setup.
reset.dialog_desc: Everything is deleted: members, pictures, tasks, points, events, wall devices, sign-in tokens and settings. NestWall returns to the first-run setup.

reset.warning: Your data cannot be brought back from this screen. The backup taken first stays in the backup history for 30 days, and you can restore it from there. The backup schedule and keep count go back to their defaults.
reset.keep_backup: A backup is taken first and kept for 30 days. If backup encryption was on, the same passphrase opens that copy.
reset.working: Resetting NestWall. This page reloads when it is done.
